what: The window unfolds from a point 20px inside the top left — the clip first becomes a handle cell (40px square) (1s), then from .2s it extends to the right edge and from 1s to the bottom edge (all cubic-bezier(.33,0,0,1), 4px corners). Once fully open, the surface-color veil covering the window lifts in .45s power2.out and the header icons pop out with back.out(1.6) .55s, .05 apart.

options.dur: Length of one fan-out spread (seconds), default 1 — with several windows, increase delay by .04 each
options.inset: Inner distance of start point (px), default 20
options.handle: Side length of the handle cell that becomes the first branch (px), default 40
options.on: With scroll, it starts when 15% enters the screen, by default as soon as it attaches
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: (If present) Icons that pop out after fully unfolded

use: <section data-fx="clip-unfold-window" data-fx-clip-unfold-window="delay: .04"><header><button data-fx-part="icon">⠿</button>Your window name here<button data-fx-part="icon">+</button></header>…</section>
note: Curtain color is --kf-surface. Measured once when it attaches to the window size, so for windows whose size is set late, attach data-fx after the size settles

from.where: index.js revealWin (original widget loader — --loader-clip-t/r/b/l · 1s original curve · -=0.8 · -=0.2 · curtain .45 power2.out · icon back.out(1.6) .55 · .04 per window)
